messages:
rhea: heads-up: the /generate API example in openapi.yaml shows 'files' as an array of {filename, content}. That shape doesn't match the SDKs (they expect an object keyed by filename). Quickstart Go example is failing CI because of this.

josh: where exactly? can you paste the snippet or PR?

rhea: openapi.yaml -> paths./generate.requestBody.content.application/json.example. current snippet: 

rhea: ```json
{
  "model": "redwood-alpha-1",
  "input": "summarize this",
  "files": [
    {"filename": "notes.txt", "content": "..."}
  ]
}
```

irene: yep that's wrong. runtime + SDKs use: 

irene: ```json
{
  "model": "redwood-alpha-1",
  "input": "summarize this",
  "files": {
    "notes.txt": "..."
  }
}
```

josh: ok, plan: 1) patch openapi example, 2) update code snippets (curl/node/python/go), 3) add migration note under breaking changes + changelogs. Who wants which?

rhea: i can open a docs PR to change the openapi example and add a short migration note. i'll link it here.

irene: i'll update python + node snippets and add a tiny example test in docs/examples to assert example shape matches runtime expectations.

sam: i'll handle server-side: for now produce a friendly 400 if array arrives with message: "files must be an object keyed by filename (arrays deprecated). See docs migration guide: /docs/migration#files-shape". created ticket INF-1105. full array-to-object fallback would need broader review.

josh: i'll update Go quickstart and add changelog entry for Go client. also add a note in the SDK release notes.
